Initial release of smyx-office-worker-posture-warning-analysis:

- Real-time analysis of office workers’ sitting posture using fixed workstation cameras.
- Detects continuous sitting duration, neck forward angle, back curvature, shoulder asymmetry, and eye-to-screen distance.
- Provides alerts for prolonged sitting, poor posture, shoulder imbalance, and excessive screen proximity through PC popup, smart speaker, or mobile app.
- Strict open-id acquisition and privacy guidelines enforced for data query and report access.
- Supports historical report lookup and outputs results in structured Markdown tables with direct report links.
- Designed for integration into enterprise security cameras or health SaaS platforms to promote workplace health.
